title: Yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- String -->
  <path d='M 50 8 Q 52 20 50 30' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- String loop at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='3'/>
  
  <!-- Left yoyo body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='28' fill='#E63946'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='20' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='12' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  
  <!-- Right yoyo body -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='28' fill='#1D3557'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='20' fill='#457B9D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='12' fill='#A8DADC'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='5' fill='#E0FBFC'/>
  
  <!-- Center axle -->
  <rect x='44' y='51' width='12' height='8' rx='4' fill='#F1FAEE'/>
  
  <!-- Left highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFB3B3' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Right highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A8DADC' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom shine left -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='65' r='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom shine right -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='65' r='3' fill='#6DB3D4' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative dots on left -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='55' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  
  <!-- Decorative dots on right -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='40' r='2' fill='#A8DADC'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='2' fill='#A8DADC'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='55' r='2' fill='#A8DADC'/>
</svg>
